mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_usage (member_id, warehouse_id, total_area, storage_cost_per_area, base_date, reg_date) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{warehouseId}, #{totalArea}, #{storageCostPerArea}, #{baseDate}, #{regDate})
mapper.select: SELECT c.warehouse_id, s.member_id, SUM(p.inbound_box_width * p.inbound_box_length * s.amount) as totalArea, wc.storage_cost_per_area FROM stock s, product p, cell c, warehouse_cost wc WHERE s.product_id = p.product_id AND s.cell_id = c.cell_id AND wc.warehouse_id = c.warehouse_id GROUP BY c.warehouse_id, s.member_id ORDER BY warehouse_id ASC LIMIT #{_skiprows}, #{_pagesize};

SELECT warehouse_id, member_id, SUM(total_area * storage_cost_per_area) AS totalStorageCost FROM daily_usage WHERE base_date >= MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + INTERVAL (#{month}-1) MONTH AND base_date < MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + INTERVAL (#{month}) MONTH
GROUP BY warehouse_id, member_id ORDER BY warehouse_id ASC LIMIT #{_skiprows}, #{_pagesize};

SELECT c.warehouse_id, ts.member_id, SUM(if(ts.change_amount > 0, ts.change_amount, 0)) as inbound_box_cnt, SUM(if(ts.change_amount < 0, -1 * ts.change_amount, 0)) as outbound_box_cnt, wc.inbound_basic_fee, wc.outbound_basic_fee FROM temp_stock ts, product p, cell c, warehouse_cost wc WHERE ts.product_id = p.product_id AND ts.cell_id = c.cell_id AND c.warehouse_id AND wc.warehouse_id AND DATE(ts.reg_date) = #{baseDate} GROUP BY c.warehouse_id, ts.member_id ORDER BY warehouse_id ASC LIMIT #{_skiprows}, #{_pagesize};
